svg.title: Curiosity, in motion.
svg.desc: A black-and-white husky with blue eyes and a curled tail chases flying pizza. A smaller black cat blinks, flicks its tail, and hops toward sushi. Pizza, maki, and nigiri cross the scene on five independent curved, spinning flights.

g.text: COMPLEX SYSTEMS. CURIOUS AGENTS. UNSUPERVISED SNACKS.
